rows.title: WS3 — Buy, tear down and measure the donor headset
rows.note: No work by me this week. The torn-down donor parts are still with John, who is using them for tests.

rows.title: WS1 — H1 Rev-C master assembly: final, fully dressed virtual headset
rows.note: Left earcup now mirrors the revised right cup, A20 board and LED clips (10 Nov); assembly v243 to v255, plus a clean 282-part assembly (12 Nov). LED diffuser ring with 3 thickness test pieces. 3-way Dupont latched connector, refitted to 14 mm housings. New grommet: 6 mm variant, 16 features locating the tension band (0.5 mm engagement in CAD). ~11 h printing, assembly and fit tests. Open: fit results not yet written down.

rows.title: WS4 — PPG REFINEMENT in the foam earcup at the mastoid
rows.note: Handed all heart-rate data to Chris/INDIA (9 Nov): 37 CSVs, 17 raw streams, 21 PDFs, app source, CAD notes; every file hash-checked. No reference device was ever used, so accuracy is unknown; 3 Nov head-tilt-left read 49.5 BPM vs 101 still. Chris now leads the testing. No new tests by me.

rows.title: WS3 — Flight-representative H1 worn and working in the aircraft (1 Dec demo)
rows.note: No direct work. Feeding it: V1 prototype assembled (WS2) and both earcups finished in CAD (WS1). Still needs the donor internals, which are with John.

rows.title: WS5 — Spectacle-arm seal test
rows.note: Not started: the week went to WS1 and the V1 build. Due date (6 Nov) has passed; needs a new date.

rows.title: WS3 — Build the demo H1: donor internals in printed shells, passthrough audio proven
rows.note: Donor internals are still with John for tests; the printed shells are ready. Due today and will be missed: needs a new date once the parts come back.

rows.title: WS2 — H1 manufacturing plan and full BOM
rows.note: Sun 8 Nov: assembled final prototype V1 (sanded cups, sprayed, glued inserts); it looks like the renders. Clear cover: the resin cast came out great but too thin, so the mould needs more silicone to be thicker; clearer printer resin is also wanted. Strap: no-sew M2 screw-clamp buckle for the 37 mm strap. Steel band: handheld bender and forming press designed (CAD, untested). Open: costed BOM.

rows.title: WS5 — Measure passive attenuation of the printed cup + cushion on the EARS Pro
rows.note: No work this week: the week went to WS1 and the V1 build.
